what: a two-start M10 thread (lead 3, pitch 1.5) over a d10 x 30 cylinder
method: ISO 68-1 basic profile (60 deg, root flat P/4 at d - 5H/4 ... minor d1 = d - 1.0825 P, crest flat P/8): a helical groove of fixed section is a screw motion, so averaged over the turn every meridian half-plane holds the same section and V = 2 pi int int r m(r) dr dz over the stock's section, m the material fraction per pitch; the groove runs out past free ends. Tolerance 0.01%: SMLib's exact screw sweep; two grooves of lead 2P, the second a half turn round from the first: every meridian half-plane holds the same sections a pitch apart as 001's one groove, so the material fraction and the volume are 001's
